key_findings: A repository is not a template and a template is not a block; most prior-sweep hits are scaffolds or frameworks, not app-level B2B templates.
Demand concentrates: case_workflow is primary for 6/17 industries and portal is secondary for 6/17; marketplace has no demand anchor.
Supply/demand inversion: the two highest-demand archetypes have the thinnest clean-license supply, so case_workflow + portal is the build case, not the borrow case.
Direct gh api re-query overturned license assumptions on 5/17 rows (2 copyleft, 3 NOASSERTION) and found calcom/cal.com now redirects to calcom/cal.diy.
